items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: La Rocca left and came back home and I was finished at Nix and they asked me would I join them and I joined them.

ctx.x: I'm sorry, most of all I missed Shields, the only chance I ever had to hear him. Then they got that Dixieland band together and traveled around the country and I just missed them in Memphis and I missed them down here about 1937. Yeah, I played with them. Yeah, you made some records then when La Rocca left.
La Rocca left and came back home and I was finished at Nix and they asked me would I join them and I joined them. Did you travel with them?
